function_signature: static boolean checktree(int preorder[], int inorder[], int postorder[], int N)
prompt_text: Write a Java solution for the GeeksforGeeks problem 'Check Tree Traversal'. Given preorder, inorder and postorder traversals of a binary tree of size N, determine whether they correspond to the same tree.

bug_analysis.bug_description: The solution correctly verifies whether the given preorder, inorder and postorder traversals belong to the same binary tree.
